_note: Prompts de l'essai, chapitre 9 (l'étoile filante). Les marqueurs {STYLE}, {CELESTIN}, {LOUISE}, {MINI}, {CHOPIN} sont remplacés par les blocs de references/FICHES-PERSONNAGES.md (voir le script).

blocs.STYLE: detailed gouache illustration, 1920s French art deco poster style, hand-painted, visible brush texture, warm paper grain, limited palette of deep Prussian blue, ink black, brick red and warm cream, soft cinematic lighting, Toulouse December 1925
blocs.CELESTIN: Célestin, a 28-year-old man with tousled dark brown hair, round wire-rimmed glasses, a lopsided smile that starts in the eyes, grey wool waistcoat over a cream shirt with rolled sleeves, a faint smudge of Prussian blue paint on his thumb
blocs.LOUISE: Louise, a 26-year-old woman with a short dark brown bob haircut in 1920s garçonne style, large dark eyes that look a little surprised, a little angry and very attentive, deep red lipstick, champagne-coloured beaded dress
blocs.MINI: small open-top yellow 1920s Citroën Type C two-seater with round headlamps, canvas roof folded back
blocs.CHOPIN: large grey cat with yellow eyes, aloof expression

negatif_image: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, modern clothes, smartphone, neon, text, watermark, signature, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry, lowres, cartoon chibi

plans.chapitre: Ch. 9 — « Elle apparut au-dessus de la ville, vers l'est… »
plans.image_prompt: {STYLE}. Wide shot of a long straight country road between frozen fields at night, a {MINI} parked at the roadside seen from behind and to the side, its two round headlamps cutting the dark, a faint distant glow of the city of Toulouse on the eastern horizon, immense pure December sky full of stars, one thin white-blue streak of a shooting star crossing the sky above the city, white frost on the fields, bare poplar trees, no people visible
plans.video_prompt: A calm night scene on a frozen country road. A single white-blue shooting star streaks across the sky from left to right above the distant city lights and fades, leaving a pale trail. The two round headlamps of the small yellow car glow steadily. A thin breath of mist drifts over the frosty fields. The camera stays still with a very slow push-in. Painterly gouache texture, subtle film grain.

plans.chapitre: Ch. 9 — « Célestin freina… la tête levée vers le ciel, le cœur battant. »
plans.image_prompt: {STYLE}. Medium close-up, three-quarter view of {CELESTIN}, wearing a long dark overcoat, sitting at the wheel of a {MINI}, both hands on the steering wheel, head tilted up toward the night sky with an awed expression, soft warm glow from the dashboard lighting his face, a small wristwatch on his wrist, dark starry sky behind him, calm expression, mouth closed
plans.video_prompt: A young man with round glasses sits at the wheel of an open car at night, head tilted up toward the sky. Slowly he lets out a breath that mists in the cold air, then gently closes his eyes for a moment and opens them again. The dashboard glow flickers softly on his face. The camera stays still. Very gentle motion, painterly gouache texture, subtle film grain.

plans.chapitre: Ch. 9 — « Même dans le noir, il vit qu'elle pleurait et qu'elle riait en même temps. »
plans.image_prompt: {STYLE}. Medium shot of {LOUISE}, a wool blanket around her shoulders, sitting on the stone sill of an open first-floor window of a brick and stone house with grey slatted shutters, legs dangling outside, bare wisteria branches climbing the wall, a {CHOPIN} sitting beside her on the sill, frosty garden, night sky with stars above, tears and a smile on her face, looking down toward the garden, calm expression, mouth closed
plans.video_prompt: A young woman wrapped in a blanket sits on a window sill at night, legs dangling outside. She looks up at the sky, then lowers her eyes toward the garden below and smiles through her tears. Her breath mists softly. A large grey cat beside her blinks slowly. Bare wisteria branches sway very slightly. The camera stays still. Very gentle motion, painterly gouache texture, subtle film grain.
